title: Provenance ledger harvest record
description: One line of provenance/harvests.jsonl — a single knowledge claim adopted from an external source into this repo's own artefacts. Sibling of provenance-borrow.schema.json, which covers borrowed CODE; this one covers borrowed IDEAS. Contract: provenance/README.md. Enforced by src/scripts/lint_harvest_provenance.ts (hand-rolled validator, following the provenance-borrow precedent — this file documents the contract; it is not loaded at runtime).

harvest_id.description: Kebab-case slug naming the harvested mechanism. This is the id an artefact cites; it must be unique across the ledger.

stated_in.description: Repo-relative path of the artefact asserting the claim, optionally suffixed ':<line>'. The path must exist.

source_ref.description: Either a public source pinned to a revision ('<url>@<sha>'), or an opaque token ('opaque:<id>' / 'ENC1:<payload>') when source-confidentiality keeps the source name out of the tracked tree. A bare URL with no revision is rejected — an unpinned reference cannot be re-verified.

evidence_locator.description: Where inside the source the claim was read — a file:line, a section anchor, or an equivalent locator. Free-form because sources differ, but never empty: a claim whose evidence cannot be located again is not a citation.

verdict.description: How the mechanism entered this repo. Only adopt and adapt produce a row — a rejected, already-present, or unclear finding is recorded in the analysis document, never in the ledger, because nothing in the tree cites it.
